location_description: Moon Township is a township along the Ohio River in Allegheny County, Pennsylvania, United States.  Moon  is a part of the Pittsburgh Metro Area and is located 12 miles (19 km) northwest of Pittsburgh. The population was 27,261 at the 2020 census.
